blocks.text: MUNAI, Lanao del Norte — For 35-year-old Anisah Madkura, getting medicines for her allergies without spending money was a welcome relief as rising healthcare costs continue to burden families with limited means. Madkura was among the residents of Barangay Lininding in Munai, Lanao del Norte, who received free medical consultations and medicines during a community outreach program conducted by the Philippine Army’s 44th Infantry Battalion on October 18. She received cetirizine for allergies and paracetamol during the medical mission, which was held ahead of the battalion’s 49th founding anniversary.
